name: Honor Students
summary: Brock Stoneseeker sends an order from Thelsamar to Ironforge for honorary mining picks. He asks you to enlist Thorgrum Borrelson to carry it there.

sections.title: A Miner's Due
sections.body: Brock teaches new miners about rock composition and tunnel safety. He rewards the apprentices who distinguish themselves with honorary picks. Mining sustains Thelsamar, and dwarves take pride in the craft. Local supplies are limited, so the picks must come from Ironforge across Khaz Modan.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: Thorgrum tends the gryphon roost beside Thelsamar, linking the frontier to Ironforge through the kingdom's aerial courier network. Bring Brock's order to him, and he can arrange a swift courier run to the capital's foundries.

faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar. He trains novices in excavation and stonecraft.

faq.q: Why does Brock need picks from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Brock needs honorary picks for students who excel at mining, but local supplies are limited. His order must reach Golnir Bouldertoe, a mining supplies vendor in Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Thorgrum Borrelson play in this task?
faq.answer: Thorgrum Borrelson tends Thelsamar's gryphon roost. Brock asks you to bring him the order so he can arrange aerial transport to Ironforge.

faq.q: Who receives the list in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe receives the list in Ironforge. He prepares honorary picks for Brock's accomplished students.

faq.q: Where does this errand lead next?
faq.answer: After you speak with Thorgrum Borrelson, he arranges a gryphon flight to Ironforge. There, you can deliver Brock's order to Golnir Bouldertoe.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
faq.answer: You begin and finish in Thelsamar, a settlement in the hills of Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a miner, you see how dwarves honor skill in the craft. Mastering stone and finding veins can earn recognition from an instructor.
As a dwarf, you see the bond between frontier settlements like Thelsamar and the capital's halls deep in the mountains.
As an Alliance traveler in Loch Modan, you encounter the flight masters and aerial couriers who link its settlements.
